purpose: Offline remesh comparison for three existing house exteriors; distinct authored modular houses are used for functional doors/windows.
method: Meshy quad topology target20,000 polygons; exported triangle counts measured from GLB, not assumed equal to the requested polygon count.

review.decision: Adopt remesh for near exterior LOD, derive12k/3k farther levels with Blender
review.positive: Roof tiles, window lines and plaster texture less broken than direct aggressive collapse at similar triangle budgets
review.remaining: Painted shutter imperfections, mesh fused door/window units; source exteriors have no validated interiors or functional openings
